guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description distinguishes reporting requirements with different criteria, including a further report when fatalities occur even if the accident has already been reported. The missing gateways, reporting task, and flow indicate that these decisions and their resulting action were not modeled. This refines FID-01 by clarifying that separate criteria must remain independently evaluable.)

same as LRN-052 (The label pairs show gateways and activities whose labels alter or omit the described decision criteria or action. The descriptions state the applicable reporting criteria and actions. LRN-052 already advises preserving the specific meaning in BPMN labels and avoiding substitutions.)

same as LRN-054 (The description gives distinct reporting duties for serious or fatal accidents, accidents meeting the specified work-incapacity threshold, and fatalities; the missing flow F18 shows a qualifying insurance-report branch was omitted. LRN-054 already expresses the same guideline for separate eligibility criteria that may both apply.)

same as LRN-021 (The description distinguishes reporting criteria and deadlines, while the gateway label pairs show differences in how those criteria are represented. LRN-021 already advises preserving explicit qualifiers in labels, so this guideline expresses the same principle.)

same as LRN-054 (The description specifies distinct reporting duties with different criteria and deadlines, including a fatality report (S13) and reporting to the accident insurance provider (S8); the absent reporting activity is recorded in M2. LRN-054 already advises independently evaluating qualifying paths and modeling each corresponding reporting action. The proposed wording is generalized to reporting duties)

same as LRN-052 (The label pairs show semantic substitutions or loss of stated meaning. The description gives the reporting conditions and actions (S7, S8, S13), supporting faithful labels. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-052; documented guideline FID-03 also advises short, faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description specifies multiple required reports or notifications with separate eligibility criteria, and one case may meet more than one criterion.: Model each criterion as an independently evaluated decision path and connect every qualifying path to its corresponding reporting action, allowing multiple paths to proceed for the same case.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies multiple required reports or notifications with separate eligibility criteria, and one case may meet more than one criterion.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies a specific trigger, decision criterion, or performed activity: Use a concise BPMN label that expresses that meaning; do not substitute a related event, outcome, or different decision.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies a decision criterion, threshold, or action to be performed

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity with explicit alternatives or qualifiers that distinguish its scope: Label the corresponding BPMN element concisely while preserving those stated distinctions; do not generalize them away.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states qualifying details that determine whether an activity applies or what a decision represents
